Tucker Carlson and Marjorie Taylor Greene Break with Republican Party

Tucker Carlson has reportedly quit the Republican Party after 35 years, an event some outlets attribute to "The Trump Effect." Concurrently, former US congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene also announced her decision to stop backing the Republican Party, citing that she is "fed up" with a party she claims "betrays its voters." This development sees Greene aligning herself with Carlson, while Carlson's relationship with Donald Trump has reportedly deteriorated over disagreements, particularly concerning US policy toward Iran.
